desc:
🥕 Welcome to Pull a Root!

How to Play:
💪 Time your grip and pull roots out of the ground
⛏️ The longer the root, the deeper it goes and the rarer the find
🦖 Find fossils, gems, treasure and secret Relics deep underground
🌱 Plant your finds in your garden to earn money
⚡ Buy more Pull Power to reach deeper layers
🍀 Hunt Lucky Roots for even rarer finds

🎁 CODES:
RELEASE, ROOTS

👍 Like & ⭐ Favorite for more updates!
